evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jevic: 'this should take about ten to fifteen minutes so we can provide you an accurate estimate. Sounds good.' [No wait for yes; moved straight to name gathering]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jevic: 'aside from the price what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?' [Asked early, before major probing]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Clark raises TV boxing concern. Jevic answers but does not dig deeper with 'tell me more' follow-ups; treats each concern as a one-off response and pivots.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: [No summary reflection of concerns heard; Jevic acknowledges but does not reflect back 'So what I'm hearing is...']
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jevic: 'typical one bedroom apartment usually takes two and two movers, one truck between two and a half to three and a half hours' and 'in your case since you are moving from a second floor apartment with stairs access...I would expect you to be within that range'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jevic: trip fee $140, no hidden fees, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments all stated. Fuel, taxes, insurance, pads, tools included.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: [Never asked 'does that feel fair?' or equivalent; Jevic moves directly to schedule availability]
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Jevic: 'if we can't make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Jevic: 'up to $2,000 per remove to repair, replace or reimburse' for accidental damages, framed as built-in coverage (no deductible, no fine print language used)
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: [No 'does that put those to rest?' or similar closing question on the Two Promises; coverage was mentioned early unprompted, not tied to a promise close]
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Jevic: 'Do you have any other questions or anything for me?' [Generic throwaway, not 'What's still concerning you?' variant]
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Jevic: 'would you like our help with your, with your move, the Saturday, there's only one schedule left 3:00 PM' [Direct ask, no built-in out]
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Customer asked for callback; Jevic offered to email details and said 'just give us a callback and we'll be more than happy to save the schedule for you.' Date (Saturday 3:00 PM window), phone (implied via callback), and addresses confirmed; crew size and detailed notes for crew not explicitly confirmed.

top_strength: Jevic gathered comprehensive logistics details (both addresses, floor plans, walking distances, special items) and positioned the damage coverage and on-time guarantee clearly, making the value prop concrete and reducing customer anxiety about the two large TVs.
coaching_note: After the customer raised concerns (TV boxing, reassembly specifics), dig deeper with follow-up questions instead of pivoting; also ask 'does that feel fair?' after pricing and confirm booking details (crew size, notes for movers about TV mounting concern) before ending the call, rather than defaulting to callback-only.
